newsitem.title: USA: Lernout & Hauspie buys three companies.
newsitem.headline: Lernout & Hauspie buys three companies.

text.p: Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products HV said it had signed letters of intent to acquire three, privately-held translation companies in Europe for a total of nearly $10 million in cash and bonds.
The company said in a statement the acquisitions would be accretive to its earnings per share. It also said it would merge the companies into its Mendez subsidiary.
It said it would buy Lexitrans of Spain for $5.2 million in cash and convertible bonds. Lexitrans made translations for computer software.
Lernout & Hauspie said it would buy Germany's Translingua for $3.3 million in cash and convertible bonds. Translingua made translations for software companies like Microsoft Corp.
It said the third company that it would buy for $100,000 in cash was Italian, which worked with software and multimedia.

Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products develops speech technology for commercial products in four primary markets: telecommunications, computers and multimedia, automotive electronics and consumer electronics.
